comment: Android hardware key-attestation trust anchors for device enrolment (N-031; backend AttestationTrust = SHA-256 of the root certificate DER, lower-case hex). Public data. Source: the root certificates published on the page below, retrieved 2026-10-07 by the infra lane. Kept: the two current roots (RSA, expires 2042; ECDSA 'Key Attestation CA1', signs chains from 2026-02-01, expires 2035) and the two previously issued roots that are still valid (expire 2034 and 2036, older phones may still chain to them). Left out: the previously issued root that expired 2026-05-24 (c1984a3e...). Re-check the page when Google announces a new root.
